==Goal==

'''Hippos & Crocodiles''' is an abstract strategy game for 2 players designed by Néstor Romeral Andrés. The goal is to place animal pieces onto the board. If you cannot place a piece on your turn, you lose immediately; the last player to place a piece wins!

==Setup==

* One player controls the '''Hippos''' (brown) and has 8 hippo pieces in reserve.
* The other player controls the '''Crocodiles''' (olive green) and has 8 crocodile pieces in reserve.
* The game is played on one of four maps (table option '''Map'''; choose '''Random''' to have one of the four picked at random when the game starts):
** '''Square''': 14×14 grid (196 squares), the default.
** '''Rectangle''': 20×10 grid (200 squares).
** '''Lagoon''': a meandering lagoon, 19 rows of 11 squares each, drifting right, centre, left, centre and right again from top to bottom (209 squares).
** '''Pool''': the round pool board, 16×16 grid with the corners cut off (208 squares).
* Animals can only cover squares of the map: nothing may stick out over the green frame.

==Animal distribution==

Table option '''Animal distribution''':
* '''Random''' (default): who plays the Hippos and who plays the Crocodiles is decided at random.
* '''First player plays Hippos''' / '''First player plays Crocodiles''': the player who starts gets that animal. When you start a rematch from the end of a game, BGA rotates the starting player, so the animals swap automatically (with '''Random''' the animals are drawn again).

==Trunks (optional)==

Trunks are brown rectangles of 3×1 squares that act as obstacles: no animal can be placed on top of them. They can be placed horizontally or vertically, must fit completely inside the map and cannot overlap another trunk. The more trunks, the shorter the game. Table option '''Trunks''':
* '''Off''': no trunks (default).
* '''On - players place 2 each''': before the first animal, the players take turns placing trunks, the first player starting, until each has placed 2. Tap a square, use '''Left'''/'''Right''' to switch between horizontal and vertical, then '''Confirm trunk'''.
* '''On - randomly placed''': 4 trunks are placed at random before the game, never touching each other, so that both players can still move.

==Animals==

Each animal occupies exactly 10 squares on the board:
* '''Hippo''': A 3×3 square body with a single protruding snout cell.
* '''Crocodile''': A central spine of 6 squares with two pairs of legs extending out to width 3.

==Your turn==

{| class="wikitable"
! # !! Action !! Description
|-
| 1 || '''Pick placement''' || On a touch screen: tap an unoccupied board cell where your animal can fit. Animals can be placed in any of the 4 cardinal orientations (0°, 90°, 180°, 270°). The marked circle is the pivot: it stays on the same square when you rotate.
|-
| 2 || '''Rotate''' || Use the '''Left''', '''Right''' and '''180°''' buttons to change orientation.
|-
| 3 || '''Confirm''' || (Touch screens.) Click '''Confirm placement''' to lock in your move. Animals cannot overlap each other or a trunk, or extend beyond the map.
|}

'''With a mouse''': move the pointer over a square to see a transparent preview of your animal with its pivot on that square, and click to place it at once (no Confirm step). Press '''A''' (rotate left), '''D''' (rotate right) or '''S''' (rotate 180°) to turn the preview; the Left/Right/180° buttons work too.

==Game end==

* When an active player cannot place any of their remaining animals legally onto the board, that player loses immediately.
* The other player is declared the winner!
